text.1_Chapter, 8_Verse, 0_Comment: The Tet (ט) is small since on the ninth (ט) of Av the House (i.e. the Holy Temple) was destroyed. And in the book Mesoret Habrit Hagadol it is written that it (the small Tet) is to hint that the sinking (of the Temple?) was not very deep, rather a shallow sinking. Nonetheless, the diggers were not able to find it for it was miraculously hidden from their eyes.
